meta.title: Solum
meta.description: Barrier-led skincare for Bangladesh — clean formulas, clear routines.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Solum collects, uses, and protects your personal data in Bangladesh.
privacy.s1Body: Account email, delivery address, phone when provided, order history, and basic device data needed to run the store. Payment card numbers never touch our servers — prepaid flows use the payment provider.
privacy.s2Body: We use your data to fulfil orders, prevent fraud, send transactional email, and improve the catalog. Marketing email only with consent. Staff access is role-based and audited.
privacy.s3Body: You can update your profile, export or delete account data from Account settings, or email privacy@example.com. We keep order records as required for tax and dispute handling.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.metaDescription: Terms for shopping on Solum — pricing, accounts, and acceptable use.
terms.s1Body: Solum sells skincare to customers in Bangladesh. Prices are in BDT. Product information is provided in good faith; always patch-test and follow on-pack directions.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for keeping login details safe. Orders are offers to buy; we may cancel for stock, fraud, or pricing errors and will notify you. Checkout and payment terms arrive with those features.
terms.s3Body: Do not abuse the site, scrape beyond fair use, or attempt unauthorized access. We may suspend accounts that harm customers, staff, or systems.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.metaDescription: How Solum delivers across Bangladesh — zones, timing, and tracking.
shipping.s1Body: We ship within Bangladesh. Delivery zones and weight-based charges are configured in Admin → Courier; checkout will show the applicable fee before you confirm.
shipping.s2Body: Most metro orders leave the warehouse within 1–2 business days after confirmation. Outside major cities, allow extra transit time. You will receive a tracking number when the parcel ships.
shipping.s3Body: If a parcel cannot be delivered, we will attempt re-delivery or arrange return per courier rules. Keep your phone reachable on the delivery day.

returns.title: Returns
returns.metaDescription: Solum return policy for unopened skincare products.
returns.s1Body: Unopened products in original sealed packaging may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Opened or used skincare cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, except for a verified defective or wrong item.
returns.s2Body: Contact support from your order page or email support@example.com with the order number and photos if relevant. Approved returns get a return slip and instructions.
returns.s3Body: Refunds go back to the original payment method or store credit once the warehouse receives and checks the parcel. COD refunds may take longer to process.
